court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
respondents: Commissioner, Greater Chennai Corporation and Others
case_number: WP No. 15015 of 2026 and WMP No. 16727 of 2026
advocates: For Respondents : Mr. D.B.R. Prabhu Stdg. Counsel, for RR 1 to 3
judgment_text:
Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issue of writ of mandamus directing Respondents 1 to 3 to inspect the demolition activities of the 4th Respondent at Door No. 32/6, Chanda Sahib Sreet, Royapettah, Chennai 600014, and to take appropriate action in accordance with law by stopping any unauthorized or unsafe construction so as to protect the petitioner's property.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks leave of the Court to withdraw the writ petition. An endorsement is also made to that effect.

2. The writ petition is, therefore, dismissed as withdrawn. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, the interim application stands closed.
